chart.title: Number of electoral democracies by age
chart.subtitle: Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem. Electoral democracies are political systems that hold meaningful, free and fair, and multi-party elections.

Number of closed autocracies.descriptionProcessing: We only count the countries that V-Dem covers in the given year. Where we impute a country's data from a historical entity it was part of, those imputed values are excluded from the count, because the country did not yet exist separately at the time.
